catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class fits one raw geometry_msgs/Twist publication. cap.motion.mobile_base.v1 requires duration_s and returns measured distance_m, heading_rad and stopped, while the gz-sim drive plugins consume the published Twist and publish no motion or completion acknowledgement. This binding sets only linear.x and angular.z; a rosbridge publication receipt is transmission evidence only.
No catalogue class observes simulation time. cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 act on a world; none subscribes to /clock or carries a rosgraph_msgs/Clock sample.

cap.sensing.imu.v1 is a read class whose output requires three-element linear_acceleration and angular_velocity arrays plus sampled_at. This binding returns the raw sensor_msgs/Imu object fields and the RosDriver result mapping has no array-assembly or timestamp conversion, so the class output cannot be produced without inventing a transformation.
No catalogue class carries a 2-D sensor_msgs/LaserScan observation. cap.sensing.point_cloud.v1 is an artifact-producing 3-D point-cloud capture, not a range array with angle and range metadata.

No catalogue class observes a nav_msgs/Odometry topic as an explicit read; the raw wheel odometry left the device resource because DiffDrive publishes it from the world update, which is silent while the e-stop holds the world paused, so the package exposes it as an extension read with an inline output schema.

No catalogue class unpauses a gz-sim world through ros_gz's ControlWorld service; it is the declared re-enable (CORE-086) after the e-stop's pause, an input-free extension command that first publishes a zero Twist and reports only that the request answered success and that the zero was handed to rosbridge.

notes:
BLOCKED (HELPER_MISSING) on the missing acknowledged stop for the ROS effectful control surface. Last gate run 2026-11-05T07:34:44Z, backend fake, report digest sha256:ba527ebe07838e6ae6d338fac99cab74af24af3bd452a0f0bd9d9aba26cbb4c4: G1 pass Layout and isolation; G2 pass Lock; G3 pass Strict resolve; G4 pass Provenance; G5 pass Reference; G6 fail Behaviour with G6.ESTOP_FAILED: mhs.safety.estop status failed, MHS.SAFETY.SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED, the latch stays engaged; G7 pass Native surface; G8 fail Protocol and surface with G8.CONFORMANCE (MHS-Sim CL3 not achieved, level CL2; failing required test SAFE-028) and G8.TEST (SAFE-028 e-stop receipt failed and safe_state.achieved=false); G9 NOT_RUN after the failing gates. There are no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings.

WHAT WAS AUTHORED: a configuration-only ROS 2 RosDriver for the pinned Gazebo topic graph. Primary control: one geometry_msgs/msg/Twist publication on /cmd_vel (linorobot2_gazebo/launch/gazebo.launch.py:141; the 2WD/vattenkar DiffDrive command topic is linorobot2_description/urdf/controllers/diff_drive.urdf.xacro:7, and the 4WD skid-steer and mecanum macros declare the same topic at skid_steer.urdf.xacro:7 and omni_drive.urdf.xacro:7). Resource reads: pose and twist from /odom/unfiltered (gazebo.launch.py:142). Explicit observation capabilities: /clock (rosgraph_msgs/msg/Clock), /imu/data (sensor_msgs/msg/Imu) and /scan (sensor_msgs/msg/LaserScan), all cited to gazebo.launch.py:140-145 and the sensor declarations (generic_laser.urdf.xacro:6-14, imu.urdf.xacro:16-22). The physical microcontroller firmware is external (docs/base_controller.md:35); no Python native class exists in the clone and none is invented. The card's role is sim-env and the driver mode is simulated; the chosen interface is the simulated mobile base because that is the only executable interface the clone defines.

WHY THE HELPER CANNOT COMPLETE THIS SURFACE: the clone creates no ROS service or action server. The only in-repo executable node, command_timeout, creates a Twist publisher, a Twist subscription and a 0.2 s timer (linorobot2_gazebo/linorobot2_gazebo/command_timeout.py:21-35); after 0.2 s without a nonzero command it publishes one zero Twist (command_timeout.py:37-48). A zero-velocity publication is transmission-only, and RosDriver accepts a safe-state/e-stop binding only as a fixed service or action with an application success predicate; the clone has neither. The ros_gz_bridge parameter_bridge argument list is topics only (gazebo.launch.py:136-157), so no stop, pause or reset service can be cited from the pinned text. The package therefore declares no safety_bindings and no safe-state action instead of fabricating one; the runtime latches in software and reports SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED. This is a genuine upstream stop gap, not a missing fake feature, and no zero-velocity publication is presented as a safe state.

SCOPE AND LIMITS: the /cmd_vel linear and angular inputs have no sourced numeric bound. The joystick scales in linorobot2_bringup/config/joy.yaml and the Nav2 velocity-smoother settings in linorobot2_navigation/config/navigation.yaml are client/navigation settings, [...]

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-11-05; reviewed_by stays null): Confirmed the author's block: the pinned ROS 2 Gazebo graph is driven only by the unacknowledged /cmd_vel topic (bridged to the gz-sim DiffDrive and MecanumDrive systems), the only in-repo node, command_timeout, creates no service or action, and the bridge has no service entries, so the stock e-stop fails G6.ESTOP_FAILED and G8 SAFE-028 with the latch held (HELPER_MISSING); every endpoint and ROS 2 type, the nested Odometry pose.pose and twist.twist read schemas, the operator_required twist bounds and the eight package cases were checked against the pin. Defects: five facts named robot variants their lines do not show (2WD/vattenkar, 4WD, mecanum), reversed the brake timer's order of operations, or added firmware details the cited line lacks, and nothing disclosed that command_timeout is a competing /cmd_vel publisher or that the clone's linorobot2_bringup drives a physical base through the same /cmd_vel (micro_ros_agent on /dev/ttyACM0 by default, optional joystick teleop), which the r04 pattern requires in safe_state, gaps and for the human reviewer. The reviewer narrowed those five facts, extended safe_state and added two fidelity gaps (driver.py), updated facts.md, and regenerated reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json; the gate still fails only G6 and G8 (stable digest sha256:f543b946a10eb19757e5fb191fe9ef083a35ed9d52b3784aca45e389217fcf50, unchanged from the author's run) and collect.py --strict shows no warning. For the human reviewer: The package declares only a simulation, but /cmd_vel is also the physical robot's command topic: linorobot2_bringup starts micro_ros_agent on the base serial port (/dev/ttyACM0 by default) and the docs say Gazebo preserves the microcontroller's interface, so a rosbridge endpoint on a hardware graph would move a real base with no stop. In Gazebo, command_timeout publishes one zero Twist about 0.2 s after the last nonzero command (a competing publisher, not an acknowledged stop). Unblocking needs an acknowledged stop the clone names, or an SDK profile for one.
